questions.stem: Which word best describes the sight?
questions.listenScript: Ben opens a tiny paper box, and a large paper castle unfolds from it. Everyone stops talking and asks, “How did all that fit inside?”

listenLines.text: Ben opens a tiny paper box, and a large paper castle unfolds from it. Everyone stops talking and asks, “How did all that fit inside?”

questions.explanation: The unexpected large castle causes surprise and wonder, so it is amazing.
questions.parentExplanation: 小纸盒展开成大城堡，引起强烈惊奇，amazing表示令人大为惊奇的。

questions.stem: What kind of record does the teacher open?
questions.listenScript: The school keeps a club's paper reports, member list and old photographs in one labelled folder. When a new teacher needs its history, she opens the folder to read these organised records.

listenLines.text: The school keeps a club's paper reports, member list and old photographs in one labelled folder. When a new teacher needs its history, she opens the folder to read these organised records.

questions.explanation: The paper reports and photographs are stored as an organised file in a labelled folder. This is a file, rather than a website, poster or personal diary.
questions.parentExplanation: 社团相关资料经过整理保存在一起，构成file档案，不是海报或个人日记。

translation.stem: 老师打开的是哪一种记录？
translation.listenScript: 学校把一个社团的纸质报告、成员名单和旧照片放在一个贴有标签的资料夹里。新老师要了解社团历史时，就打开资料夹查阅这些整理好的记录。

questions.stem: The rabbits run behind the wall and d________ from sight.
questions.explanation: Here, “disappear” means “stop being visible”. The plural subject rabbits takes disappear.
questions.parentExplanation: rabbits是复数，用disappear。完整句意：兔子跑到墙后，从视线里消失了。

questions.stem: The class hopes to e________ the old garden and discover which plants grow there.
questions.hint: travel around a place to learn about it

questions.parentExplanation: hopes to后面接原形explore。完整句意：全班希望探索这座老花园，了解那里长着哪些植物。

questions.stem: My friends s________ me when I practise a difficult song; they encourage me to try again.

passages.text: Several classes make a wall picture from hundreds of paper leaves for the open afternoon. Each pupil writes a kind message on a leaf before we sort them by colour. We first spread the leaves on tables beside an open window. A strong wind can blow away the light pieces, so Mia closes the window. Then we fix the leaves to a large tree shape on the wall. Visitors stop to read the messages, and we keep a photograph after the event.

parallelText.en: Several classes make a wall picture from hundreds of paper leaves for the open afternoon.
parallelText.zh: 几个班为开放日下午活动制作墙面画，用上数以百计的纸叶。

parallelText.en: Each pupil writes a kind message on a leaf before we sort them by colour.
parallelText.zh: 每位学生在一片纸叶上写下善意留言，然后我们按颜色分类。

parallelText.en: We first spread the leaves on tables beside an open window.
parallelText.zh: 我们先把纸叶铺在开着的窗户旁的桌子上。

parallelText.en: A strong wind can blow away the light pieces, so Mia closes the window.
parallelText.zh: 强风可能吹走轻纸片，所以米娅关上窗户。

parallelText.en: Then we fix the leaves to a large tree shape on the wall.
parallelText.zh: 随后，我们把纸叶固定在墙上的大树轮廓上。

parallelText.en: Visitors stop to read the messages, and we keep a photograph after the event.
parallelText.zh: 访客停下来读留言，活动后我们留下一张照片。

put things into groups by a shared feature

passages.text: Before our class picnic, the park keeper shows us a change near the lake. Workers must cut down a dead tree because a crack makes it unsafe. They leave the healthy trees standing and close only the small work area. Farther along the shore, we find plastic pollution: bags and bottles lie between the stones. We collect the rubbish with the keeper and sort it into the marked bins. At lunch, we discuss two jobs—caring for trees and keeping waste out of the park.

parallelText.en: Before our class picnic, the park keeper shows us a change near the lake.
parallelText.zh: 班级野餐前，公园管理员向我们介绍湖边的一项变化。

parallelText.en: Workers must cut down a dead tree because a crack makes it unsafe.
parallelText.zh: 一棵枯树出现裂缝、不再安全，工人必须把它砍倒。

parallelText.en: They leave the healthy trees standing and close only the small work area.
parallelText.zh: 他们保留健康的树，只封闭小块施工区。

parallelText.en: Farther along the shore, we find plastic pollution: bags and bottles lie between the stones.
parallelText.zh: 再沿湖岸走，我们发现塑料污染：袋子和瓶子落在石头间。

parallelText.en: We collect the rubbish with the keeper and sort it into the marked bins.
parallelText.zh: 我们和管理员一起收集垃圾，分类放进带标记的垃圾桶。

parallelText.en: At lunch, we discuss two jobs—caring for trees and keeping waste out of the park.
parallelText.zh: 午饭时，我们讨论两种工作：照管树木和防止垃圾留在公园里。
